hymns.title: Bwenzi lina longa Yesu
verses:
1. Bwenzi lina longa Yesu, palibe
Angathe wina kutichiritsa? Iyayi

2. Pena womfuna adakanidwa? Palibe
Adzatikaniza malo m'mwamba? Iyayi

3. Alipo mpulumutsi wina? Palibe
Woti angatithandize ife? Iyayi
hymns.chorus:
Yesu adziwa zathu zonse,
Iye adzanditsogoza.
Bwenzi lina longa Yesu, palibe

hymns.title: Chikondi ndichotu
verses:
1. Chikondi ndichotu,
Chiyanjanitsafe;
Pakukondana ifeyo
Titsanza m'mwambamo

2. Pamaso pakepo
Tigwade tonsefe
Chiyembekezo chathucho
Nchimodzimodzidi

3. Tithandizanedi
M'mavuto athuwo
Timasangalatsanatu
M'nsoni zomwenso

4. Tikalekanafe
Timamva chisoni
Tikhulupira kutitu
Tidzaonananso

hymns.title: Ndinamira m'machimo
verses:
1. Ndacumwa machimo, wosaonekanso
Ndinamera milithudi, wosaturukanso
Koma Yesu adamva, kulira kwanguko
Nandipulumutsa ku machimo

2. Mtimanga wanga ndipatsa, ndioramangara
Ndidzakhala mwa iye, ndikumyimtinabe
Mtima wanga uyimba, za chikondi chake
Lero ndidzatumikiwa Yesuyo

3. Ovulika penyani, Yesu onse
Adzakumukutsani m'malunde opsyas
Ndiye mwini nyanjayo, mafunde
Akhozadi kukupulumutsani
hymns.chorus:
Nandikweza (kweza)
Nandikweza (kweza)
Ponics m'thopemo
Andikweza
Nandikweza nandikweza
Pomira m'thopemo
Andikweza

hymns.title: Anthu aku m'mawawo
verses:
1. Anthu aku m'mawawo adatsata nyenyezi
Yotangoza beratu ndikuwara kwakeko
Momwemo tifunale kufikia kwa Ambuye

2. Adatulumwatumwachimwemwe, ku Yesu
Mwini yo namgwadina
Momwemo, mokondweta fe mila Sea

3. Napenika unthumo mphatici za mitenge wake
Kame Yesuy-tutans mule gold
Chanchic lipersikele zome zulu kweiye

4. Milyendetse Mbuyahu raz
Milletise inadi mkoa wa
Komere tidrapenyatu beeno Who yanuyo

hymns.title: Mbuye sindisamala
verses:
1. Mbuye sindisamala kukhala wachuma
Ndifuna kukalowa maziko lakumambo
M'buku lokometsatsa is ufumu wenu
Kodi lalembedwamo, Mbuye dzina langa?

2. Machimo anga alipo ambirimbiri
Koma mwazi wa Mpulumutsi wanga
Chifukwa lonsenzo palibe
Ngakhale alipo nddzanayesa

3. Kumzinda wokoma wa m'mwamba
Ndi anthu obvala zoyera
Kumene choipa sichidzarowa
Kodi dzina langa pokhala m'malo?
hymns.chorus:
Kodi dzina langa lalembedwa m'mwamba?
M'buku la ufumuwo kodi lalembedwa?

hymns.title: Ndipula Y Yesu wanga, ndikondatu
verses:
1. Ndipula Y Yesu wanga, ndikondatu
Kuni ndisacomwwy
Kundlandira moyo
Ndi chimwemwe chakacho

2. Nakondwera pakumdza Mpulumutsi wangayo
Athala nane mpaka chimaliziro

hymns.title: Sangatansa akus
verses:
1. Sangatansa akus, masiku alikutha
Pali anthu otayika, masiku alikutha
Ngati tiyondwerera pasuyenda ulendowa
Tonse zachita bwino, masiku alikutha

2. Tisakhome aulesi, masiku alikutha
Chakondlostimet lodzala ndi chisoni
Thangatani akugwa, masiku alikutha

3. Tamangowano unyolo masiku alikutha
Tisiyelu zoipa makamaka
Tonsele zabweneky Mangu
Nico Sitokondwete kuha

hymns.title: Ndifuna kuimbiradi
verses:
1. Ndifuna uyimbra
Zalenakuza Yesu
Pakandikonda ine
Yamuyo
Mane mlene amoyoko

2. Fatumus Ambuye
Wolkhamedwa bestande
Aliwonnicle dakoli
Diepe chesa

3. Uthenga wanu, Mbuyathu
Ndifuna kubukitsa
Kuti ochima enanso
Ayambe kuyimbira

hymns.title: Ndinasokera mtalimo
verses:
1. Ndinasochera mtalimo,
Mbuye ndidzako
Ndilapa tchimo langa,
Mbuye ndidzako

2. Ndamweza zaka zambi,
Mbuye ndidzako
Uwawa mtima wangawu,
Mbuye ndidzako

3. Ndatopa ndi zoipazi,
Mbuye ndidzako
Ndimvera mau anuwo,
Mbuye ndidzako

4. Anundifera Yesuyo,
Mbuye ndidzako
Ndiyembekeza Iyeyo,
Mbuye ndidzako

5. Ndisowe mwazi wenuwo,
Mbuye ndidzako
Ndisukeni ndiyere mbuu!
Mbuye ndidzako
hymns.chorus:
Ndidzako, ndidzako, ndiri kudza ko
Mwa chifundo chachitu Mbuye ndidzalio

hymns.title: Ndiribetu manyazi'ne
verses:
1. Ndiribetu manyazi'ne
Kutivomera Mbuye
Yemwe anandifera 'ne
Imfa ya pamtanda

2. Yesu ulemelero wanga
Ndidziwa mwa Iye
Iye sadzanditaya 'ne
Pa siku lipilolo

3. Ndakopekatu m'limamu
Ndi Mbuyanga Yesu
Kuti ali wamphamvutu
Wakundisungabe

4. Yerusalemu woyera
Wotsika kumwamba
Mzinda wa Mulungu wanga
Momwe ndidzakhala
hymns.chorus:
Pamtanda pamtanda
Ndidaona kuwala
Ndipo mdima wangawo usachoka
Ndionatu mbeee!
Ndiri kukondwa tsiku lonse

hymns.title: Ndiimba ndi chimwemwe
verses:
1. Ndiimba ndi chimwemwe lero:
Kale ndidalephera
Yesu adachotse machimo, Aleluya
O Aleluya - O Walowa

2. Walowa ndi chikondi chake
Mumtima wa chisoni
Tsiku lonse ndirikuyimba, O Aleluya

3. Chiyanjano chathu chinabwino
Chopose china chonse:
Pokhala ndi Yesu nakondwadi Aye

4. Bwerani ndi nkhawa zanu zonse
Kwa Yesu wokondedwa
Inunso mudzayimbe ndithu Aleluya

hymns.title: Kuli dziko lakuwala
verses:
1. Kuli dziko lakuwala ndithu
Kunthawi zosatha
Kamwe kulibe mdima be!
Chimwemwe chosathanso

2. Kuli dziko lamlendedwa
Kokhala Yesuyo
Komwe kulibe mdima be!
Chimwemwe chosathanso
hymns.chorus:
Aflanctawo!
Korona ndizavala
Pamodzi ndi woyera
Mdziko lina

hymns.title: Mulungu watafaniza
verses:
1. Mulungu watafaniza zoipa zangawo
Werengani malombe m'buku la Yesaye
Mutu 44 ndime 22
Watafaniza zoipa zanga walero

2. Yesu kuowera kutenga anthu ake
Temawerenga choncho m'buku la Yohane
Mutu ndi 14, ndime 1,2,3
Adzandilenga ndikumlendira tsopano!

3. Mau Woyera yathu natu
Tione atziowe zaru m'buku la Mateu
Timerengamo 1 1,2,3
Monga kale rechco yansuyo tapano

hymns.title: Mulungu adapatsa moyo
verses:
1. Mulungu adapatsa moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Mulungu sosapana moyo
Adapatsa moyo wosatha

2. Adakana moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Anthu adakana moyo
Adakana moyo wosatha

3. Apatsanso moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Apatsanso moyo wosatha

4. Kodi mulandira moyo?
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Kodi mulandira moyo?
Musalindire tsopano

5. Talandira moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Ife talandira moyo wosatha
Nislandes?

6. Moyo uwoneke moyo, moyo
Moyo, wosatha
Moyo uwoneke moyo, moyo
Uwoneke moyo wosatha

hymns.title: M'khola, m'khola
verses:
1. M'khola, m'khola
M'khola la ng'ombe
M'khola la ng'ombe
Kuli Yesu, Yesu wabadwa,
wabadwa, wabadwa
Kuli Yesu, Yesu wabadwa, M'khola la ng'ombe

2. Abusa, abusa
Abusa a Betlehemu
Abusa a Betlehemu
Adaona, ona angelo, angelo, angelo
Adaona, ona angelo oyimba, Hosanna!

3. Anzeru, anzeru
Anzeru aku m'mawa
Anzeru aku m'mawa
Adatsata, tsata nyenyezi, nyenyezi nyenyezi
Adatsata, tsata nyenyezi, napeza Yesuyo

4. Pofika, pofika
Pofika ku Betlehemu
Pofika ku Betlehemu
Adaona, ona mwanayo, mwanayo, mwanayo
Adaona, ona mwanayo natama Mulungu

hymns.title: Sankha yako
Ambuye alitu thanthwe
verses:
1. Ambuye alitu Thanthwe
M'mene ndibisalamo
Potchinjiriza namondwe
Odwala ndi olemawo

2. Mafunde akagundafe
Nthawi ya namondweyo
Alipo wothandiza'fe
Nthawi ya namondweyo

3. Lingatu la usikuwo
Nthawi ya namondwe
Osaopa moopsyamo
Nthawi ya namondweyo
hymns.chorus:
O! Yesu ndiye thanthwe kwa olematu
Olematu, olematu
O! Yesu ndiye thanthwe kwa olematu
Pa nthawi ya namondweyo

hymns.title: Kodi mwafunsa Yesu?
verses:
1. Kodi mwafunsa Yesu za kutsuka kwake?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
Kodi mwakhulupilira chisomocho?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?

2. Kodi mukuyenda ndi mpulumutsiyo?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
Kodi mwapuma pa mtanda wa Yesu?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?

3. Kodi mwakonzeka pakubwera kwake?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
Kodi mukalowa m'malo abwino?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
hymns.chorus:
Kodi mwatsukidwa ndi mwazi woyera wa Yesu?
Kodi zobvala zanu ndi zoyera?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?

hymns.title: Chipata chochinjikako
verses:
1. Chipata chochinjikako
Chionetsera cheza,
Kuchokatu kwa mtandawo
Chikondi chioneka

2. Chipata n'chauleretu
Kwa onse akufuna
Achuma, osaukanso,
Amtundu uliwonse

3. Pitanitu mtsogolomo
Chipata nchosatseka
Landira mtanda wakewo
Mbonitu ya chikondi

4. Patsidya tidzatulapo
Mtandawo wa manyazi
Dzabvalatu koronayo
Dzamkonda 'Ye koposa
hymns.chorus:
Mwaluba ine ko Chipata chakumwamwako?
Ine, ine mwatchinjikira ine

hymns.title: Ndalimva dziko
verses:
1. Ndalimva dziko la mtalimo
Munthu sangathe kulisimba
Malowo awala koposa
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala uko

2. Musazengereze anthuni
Chimwemwe uko chilipodi
Anthuni mudzalandiradi
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala uko

3. Mwana'we patseni mtimako
Akuchotsere zoipazo
Udzakhala wokondweradi,
E! Nkwabwino lola mwana'we

4. Idzani, mverani, lapani
Chipulumutso chiripodi
Kwa Yesu yemwe woferanu
Ndi Yesu mudzanka kumwamba
hymns.chorus:
Komweko, komweko
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala uko

hymns.title: Mundipatse mafuta
verses:
1. Mundipatse mafuta a m'nyali
Ndipemphatu Ambuye'nu
Mundipatse mafuta a m'nyali
Ndiyakebe mpaka mudzanso

2. Mundiyendetse ndinu Ambuye
Mundiphunzitse inutu
Mundiyendetse ndinu Ambuye
Ndiphunzire mpaka mudzanso

3. Mundikhalitse pansi pa mtanda
Ndipemphatu Ambuye'Nu
Mundikhalitse pansi pa mtanda
Ndigonjetu mpaka mudzanso

4. Mundipatse mtendere m'timanga
Ndipemphatu Ambuye Nu
Mundipatse mtendere m'timanga
Ndipumule mpaka mudzanso

5. Mundipatse chimwemwe m'timanga
Ndipemphatu Ambuye Nu
Mundipatse chimwemwe m'timanga
Ndiyimbire mpaka mudzanso
hymns.chorus:
Yimbirani, yimbirani
Hosana kwa mfumu ya mafumuyo!
Yimbirani, yimbirani
Hosana kwa mfumuyo!

hymns.title: Yesu afuna inu kukhala
verses:
1. Yesu afuna inu kukhala
Kuti timvere mau ake okoma
Lowani, lowani, lowani, Yesu sakana
Lowani, lowani, lowani, Yesu sakana

2. Ngati sitikondana ndi Yesu
Pobwera Yesu tidzazunzidwa

3. Anthu ati "Nafe tikapuma"
Koma sadziwa kupuma kwake

4. Yesu ati "Idzani mupumule"
Ine ndine mpumulo wa moyo

5. Mukafuna moyo mudzapeza;
Mtendere udzakhala ndi inu

6. Kodi mufuna moyo wosatha?
Mverani Yesu mwana wa Mulungu

hymns.title: Inu mwa mandotanso
verses:
1. Inu mwamandotanso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwamandotanso, Yesu akwitana
Dzani 'dzani dzanitu!
Idzani inu nonse Yesu akwitana

2. Inu mwamafumunso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwamafumunso, Yesu akwitana

3. Inu mwa amayinso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa amayinso, Yesu akwitana

4. Inu okalambanso, Yesu akwitana
Inu okalambanso, Yesu akwitana

5. Inu mwa tiananso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa tiananso, Yesu akwitana

6. Inu mwa'nyamatanso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa'nyamatanso, Yesu akwitana

7. Inu mwa mauthunso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa mauthunso, Yesu akwitana

hymns.title: Pa mtanda Mbuye adafera
verses:
1. Pa mtanda Mbuye adafera
Ndidadzapo ndi tchimo langa
Pomwe mtima wanga watsukidwa,
Ulemelera

2. Ndapulumuka modabwitsa
Yesu analowa mu mtimanga,
Pa mtanda adandilandira
Ulemelero

3. Chitsime chotsukira tchimo
Ndikondwa kuti ndalowanso,
Momwe amandidyetseramo,
Ulemelero

4. Bwera ku chitsime chokoma
'Dzigwetsere pa phazi lake,
Lumphamo lero utsukidwe,
Ulemelero
hymns.chorus:
Ulemelero kwa dzina lake
Pomwe mtimanga watsukidwa,
Ulemelero

hymns.title: Wabadwa, wabadwa
verses:
1. Wabadwa, wabadwa, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wabadwa
Wabadwa, wabadwa, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wabadwa
Mngelo adasimba, Mpulumutsi Wabadwa, (Alleluya)
Wabadwa, wabadwa, mpulumutsi Yesuyo wabadwa

2. Wauka, wauka, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wauka,
Wauka, wauka, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wauka,
Mngelo adasimba, wauka kwa akufa, (Alleluya)
Wauka, wauka, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wauka,

3. Wachoka, wachoka katundu, wa mu mtima wachoka
Wachoka, wachoka katundu, wa mu mtima wachoka
Zoipa zonse zachoka m'mwazi wake wa Yesu. (Alleluya)
Wachoka, wachoka katundu, wa mu mtima wachoka

hymns.title: Mwazi udatsika
verses:
1. Mwazi udatsika pa mtanda tidaona
Kutsuka ife unaali wa mtengo wapatali
O! Yesudi mdafera chifukwa cha ife:
Pa mtandapo onani mwaziwo woyenda

2. Ha! Kulemera mtandawo Mbuye nasenza
Womwe udamgwetsa Iye ku Gologotako.

3. Yesu mudadzukanso kumanda lero lino
Mudati, mwatha ntchito ya kupulumutsa anthu

4. Ambuye mudatiwombola ndi mwazi wanu
Chifukwa cha chikondi chanu Chopambanacho.

5. O! Yesu tikukondani tonsefe, tibwera
Chifukwa inu ndinu mwini Wamphamvu yonse.

hymns.title: Ndafika m'dziko lokoma
verses:
1. Ndafika m'dziko lokoma
Ndi zinthu zonsezo zanga;
Chisoni chonse chidzatha
Chimwemwe chokha chikhala

2. Wopulumutsa Yesuyo
Anditsogoza m'njirayo;
Alankhulana nanetu
Mpaka ndifike komweko

3. Ndiyimba za cholowachi
Ndidza chimwemwe chosatha
Chifundo chake chikhala
Pa anthu onse oyimba

4. Angelo onse ayimba
Za zinthu zonse zam'mwamba
Mipingo yonse ya Mulungu
Iyimba za mombolo'yo
hymns.chorus:
Ha! Dzikolo lokomadi
Ndingoima paphiripo
Ndiyang'anira komweko ku nyumba zokonzedwazo
Ndiyang'anira dzikolo komwe ndidzakakhalako

hymns.title: Mibvumbi ya madalitso
verses:
1. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Ili ndi lonjezano
Lidzadza nyengo ya mvula
Yotumidwa ndi Mbuye

2. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Yotitsitsimutsanso;
Pa mapiri ndi pa madambo
Pamvekedwe mvulayo

3. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Bwenzi itatigwera;
Kwa Mulungu tibvomereza
Kwa Yesu tiitana

4. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Ngati timvera ife;
Mvulayo itsanulidwa
Monga kufuna kwake.
hymns.chorus:
Mibvumbi ndiyo, ya madalitso idze
Madontho akugwa koma, mibvumbiyo itsike

hymns.title: Ndiri kuliranji?
verses:
1. Ndirikuliranji?
Sizikwana nsonizo
Kuleketsa, manthawo
Kuulula machimo
Kundipulumutsa

2. Ndikangamiranji?
Maganizo ndi nchito
Zonse zanga zabwino
Zomwe zili mtimamo
Sizindilamitsa

3. Ndili kuchedwanji?
Wotayika, wofoka
Wakuchita zoipa;
Ndikachedwa ndidzafa
Wosapulumuka

4. Ndipulupudzanji?
Yesu, ntchito adatha
Yakundipulumutsa
Mbuye mundithandize
Kukhulupilira.
hymns.chorus:
Yesu Khristu nalira,
Nandifera pa mtanda;
Ndipo andilindira
Kundipulumutsa

hymns.title: Mkulu anadza kwa Yesu
verses:
1. Mkulu anadza kwa Yesu Mbuye
Nafunsira Iye za moyo wina
Yesu adatero kwa wofunsayo
"Ukabadwensotu"

2. Nonsenu akumva mau omwewo
Adalankhulidwa ndi mfumu ija
Musapeputsebe zonena zake
Mukabadwensotu

3. Anthunu ofuna kupuma kwake
Kuyimba kumwamba za kuombola
Moyowo umene mudzakhala nawo
Mukabadwensotu

4. Ambiri ambiri amasochera
Mu njira ya imfa akunyengedwa
Idzani kwa Yesu mkhulupirireni
Ndikubadwansotu
hymns.chorus:
Mukabadwensotu! Mukabadwensotu!
Mau a mfumu ngomveka lero:
Muzibadwansotu.

hymns.title: E kwathu ndi kumwamba
verses:
1. E Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
E Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
E Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
Tidzakondwerako
Tiyeni ku mwamba ndi Ambuye Yesu
Tiyeni ku mwamba tidzakondwerako

2. E Mudzitembenukatu,
E Mudzitembenukatu,
E Mudzitembenukatu,
Kukakondwerako.

3. Muyeretsedwe m'mtimamo,
Muyeretsedwe m'mtimamo,
Muyeretsedwe m'mtimamo,
Kukakondwerako.

4. Mukhale olungamatu,
Mukhale olungamatu,
Mukhale olungamatu,
Mukakondwerako.

5. M'menyane ndi zoipazo,
M'menyane ndi zoipazo,
M'menyane ndi zoipazo,
Kukakondwerako.

6. Musenze msanga mtandawo,
Musenze msanga mtandawo,
Musenze msanga mtandawo,
Kukakondwerako.

hymns.title: Yesu apita pano
verses:
1. Yesu apita pano, pano, pano,
Yesu apita pano, apita pano lero.

2. Yesu afuna iwe, iwe, iwe,
Yesu afuna iwe, afuna iwe lero.

3. Yesu afuna ine, ine, ine,
Yesu afuna ine, afuna ine lero.

4. Yesu akonda ine, ine, ine,
Yesu akonda ine, akonda ine lero.

hymns.title: Yesu ndidzina
verses:
1. Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, la Mbuye
Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, la Mbuye
Aleluya, Aleluya, Yesu ndi dzina la Mbuye
Aleluya, Aleluya, Yesu ndi dzina la Mbuye

2. Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, kwa dziko
Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, kwa dziko

3. Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate wa moyo
Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate wa moyo

4. Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi a moyo
Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi a moyo

5. Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira ya moyo
Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira ya moyo

6. Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo lamoyo
Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo lamoyo

7. Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa wabwino
Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa wabwino

hymns.title: Mwandiitana, ndavomera
verses:
1. Mwand'itana, ndabvomera,
Mwand'itana, ndabvomera,
Mwand'itana, ndabvomera,
Ndidzakutumikirani, Ambuye.

2. M'midzi yonse ndidzayenda,
M'midzi yonse ndidzayenda,
M'midzi yonse ndidzayenda,
Ndidzakutumikirani, Ambuye.

3. Kuli konse ndidzapita,
Kuli konse ndidzapita,
Kuli konse ndidzapita,
Ndidzakutumikirani, Ambuye.

hymns.title: Yesu adampatsa madzi
verses:
1. Yesu adampatsa madziwo amoyo,
Yesu adampatsa madziwo amoyo,
Napita nasimbira. Nabwerera ndi ena,
Iwonso adafuna madziwo a moyo

2. Yesu apatsabe madziwo amoyowo,
Yesu apatsabe madziwo amoyowo,
Kwa wokhulupilira ndi wakumulandira,
Yesutu apatsabe madziwo a moyo

3. Madzi otumphukira kumoyo wosatha.
Madzi otumphukira kumoyo wosatha.
Mumtimamu mwa Khristu, Kasupeyo wa madzi
Amatumphukira kumoyo wosatha

hymns.title: Chenjera ndi maso ako
verses:
1. Chenjera ndi maso ako, chenjera
Chenjera ndi maso ako, chenjera
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi maso ako, chenjera.

2. Chenjera ndi khutu lako, chenjera
Chenjera ndi khutu lako, chenjera
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi khutu lako, chenjera.

3. Chenjera ndi mkamwa mwako, chenjera
Chenjera ndi mkamwa mwako, chenjera
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi mkamwa mwako, chenjera.

4. Chenjera ndi manja ako, chenjera
Chenjera ndi manja ako, chenjera
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi manja ako, chenjera.

5. Chenjera ndi phazi lako, chenjera
Chenjera ndi phazi lako, chenjera
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi phazi lako, chenjera.

6. Chenjera ndi mtima wako, chenjera
Chenjera ndi mtima wako, chenjera
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi mtima wako, chenjera.

hymns.title: Wanzeru anamanga
verses:
1. Wanzeru anamanga pathanthwe,
Namanga nyumba yake pathanthwe
Wanzeru anamanga pathanthwe,
Ndipo mvula idagwa
Mvula niigwaigwabe, Mvula, niigwaigwabe
Mphepo idagundanso, nyumba niima nji!

2. Wopusa anamanga pa mchenga,
Namanga nyumba yake pa mchenga
Wopusa anamanga pa mchenga
Ndipo mvula idagwa
Mvula niigwaigwabe, Mvula, niigwaigwabe
Mphepo idagundadi, nyumba idagwa phii!

hymns.title: Tchimo langa lonseli
verses:
1. Tchimo langa lonseli lachotsedwa, Lachotsedwa, lachotsedwa
Tchimo langa lonseli lachotsedwapo pamtandapo

2. Mtendere walowa m'tima mwanga, M'tima mwanga, m'tima mwanga
Mtendere walowa m'tima mwanga, pamtandapo

3. Chimwemwe chalowa m'tima mwanga, M'tima mwanga, m'tima mwanga
Chimwemwe chalowa m'tima mwanga, pamtandapo

hymns.title: Mitengo imagwedezeka
verses:
1. Mitengo imagwedezeka, Imagwedezeka, imagwedezeka
Mitengo imagwedezeka, kutama Ambuye

2. Udzunso umagwedezeka, Umagwedezeka, umagwedezeka
Udzunso umagwedezeka, kutama Ambuye

3. Pereka mtima wako wonse, Mtima wako wonse, mtima wako wonse
Pereka mtima wako wonse, kutama Ambuye

hymns.title: Kanyali kanga
verses:
1. Kanyali kanga kakang'ono
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

2. Bisa pansi padengu, ayi!
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

3. Satana asazime phuu!
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

4. M'dziko la Malawi!
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

hymns.title: Pemphera nthawi ya m'mamawa
verses:
1. Pemphera nthawi ya m'mamawa
Pemphera nthawi ya usana
Pemphera nthawi ya usiku, m'tima m'timamo

2. Ayankha nthawi ya m'mamawa
Ayankha nthawi ya masana
Ayankha nthawi ya usiku, konzeka m'tima

3. Angadze nthawi ya m'mamawa
Angadze nthawi ya masana
Angadze nthawi ya madzulo, konzeka m'tima

hymns.title: Mtima wanga uyamiketu
verses:
1. Mtima wanga uyamiketu
Mfumu yangayo kumwambako
Mtima wanga uyamiketu
Zokoma zake za Yesu

2. Ndiyamika Yesu wangayo
Anandifera, adaukanso
Andipempherera m'Mwambamo
Abweranso kutenga'ne
hymns.chorus:
Yesu, Yesu, Yesu, Inu nokhadi
Ndikuyamikani Ambuye wamoyotu

hymns.title: Chingwe cha moyo
verses:
1. Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
Mnzako akufa m'madzi ndithu
M'madzi atchimo akumiramo
Tam'gwiratu m'sanga asanafemo

2. Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
Uzengereza chifukwa ninji
Ona aimira posachedwatu
Utenge msanga bwato la moyo

3. Ali kufadi anthu ambiri
Omira m'nsoni mosalowa'we
M'mafumde a tsoka abiramo bii
Aponyere chingwe atulukemo

4. Chingwe cha moyo ndichotu Yesu
M'madzi atchimo atitulutsa
Atikometsa tisalowenso
Mombolo wathuyo ndiye Yesu
hymns.chorus:
Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
Ali kumira ndithudi
Chingwe chamoyo msangatu msanga
Apulumuke nacho

hymns.title: Akondwera lero akumwamba
verses:
1. Akondwera lero akumwambawo
Alikudza wosocherayo;
Ndi Atate akomana nayetu
Amachingamira mwanayo

2. Dzulo adagona m'thengo moopsya
Lero adzagona m'kholamo
Dzulo idam'gwira njala ya mtima
Lero Yesu amudyetsatu

3. Dzulo kumva ludzu mkamwa muli gwa!
Lero anamwa madzi amoyo
Dzulo adavala nsanza zakezo
Lero Yesu amubvekatu

4. Kale adachita zosayenera
Lero alekana nazo
Dzulo nubvutika mtima wakewo
Lero akondwerera nafetu.
hymns.chorus:
Yimba, yimba, tiyimbitsetu!
Imva, imva akumwambanso,
Pakuona anthu ochulukawo,
Ndiwo ake ake a Yesu

hymns.title: Mukawerenga mau
verses:
1. Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu,
Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu,
Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu,
Mudzakula mwa Yesu,
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu

2. Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku,
Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku,
Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku
Mudzakula mwa Yesu,
Mudzakula mwa Yesu,
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku
Mudzakula mwa Yesu

hymns.title: Ndatsimikiza kutsata
verses:
1. Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu,
Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu,
Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo

2. Ngakhale ndekha ndidzam'ngotsata,
Ngakhale ndekha ndidzam'ngotsata,
Ngakhale ndekha ndidzam'ngotsata
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo

3. Za mdziko mbuyo mtanda m'tsogolo,
Za mdziko mbuyo mtanda m'tsogolo,
Za mdziko mbuyo mtanda m'tsogolo
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo

4. Ngakhale m'bvuto ndidzam'ngotsata,
Ngakhale m'bvuto ndidzam'ngotsata,
Ngakhale m'bvuto ndidzam'ngotsata
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo.

hymns.title: Ndiri ndi chimwemwe
verses:
1. Ndiri ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
Mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu
Ndiri ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
Mum'timangamu, Aleluya

2. Ndiri ndi mtendere wopambana
Mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu
Ndiri ndi mtendere wopambana
Mum'timangamu, Aleluya

3. Ndiri naye mzimu woyera
Mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu
Ndiri naye mzimu woyera
Mum'timangamu, Aleluya

hymns.title: Ndapulumutsidwa
verses:
1. Ndapulumutsidwa, Ndapulumutsidwa,
Ndi mwazi wake wa Yesu, Ndapulumutsidwa

2. Ndakhululukidwa, ndakhululukidwa
Ndi mwazi wake wa Yesu, Ndakhululukidwa

3. Ndatchinjirizidwa, Ndatchinjirizidwa,
Ndi moyo wake wa Yesu, Ndatchinjirizidwa.

4. Ndayanjanitsidwa, Ndayanjanitsidwa,
Ndi mwana wake wa Mulungu, Ndayanjanitsidwa.

hymns.title: Anthu onse adziwe
verses:
1. Anthu onse adziwe, anthu onse adziwe
Ayenera adziwe, Mbuye Yesu
Ndiye wakukoma mtima, ndiye wo-pambanalu,
Ndiye mpulumutsi wanga, anthu onse adziwe

2. Anthu onse adziwe, anthu onse adziwe
Ayenera adziwe, ntchito yake
Yesu adafera ife, nasauka pamtanda
Kuti tikalowe m'mwamba, tikakhale nayeko.

hymns.title: Anyamata, asungwana
verses:
Anyamata, asungwana mtsateni'nu mtsateni
Afunitsa inu nonse mtsateni'nu mtsateni
Anapeza mavutowo napereka moyo wake
Namwa ndulu m'malo mwathu mtsateni'nu mtsateni.

hymns.title: Yimbani nyimbo mumtima
verses:
Imbani nyimbo mumtima, imbani nyimbo mumtima
Imbani nyimbo mumtima kwa Mfumu ya mafumu
Mulambireni iye mulemekezeni
Imbani nyimbo mumtima kwa Mfumu ya mafumu

hymns.title: Yesu wandifera, Yesu wandifera
verses:
Yesu wandifera, Yesu wandifera
Ndimkondadi chifukwa wandifera

hymns.title: Mzimu wa Mulungu'nu
verses:
Mzimu wa Mulungu Nu mugwe pa ine
Mzimu wa Mulungu'Nu mugwe pa ine
Mundikonze, mundikonze
Mzimu wa Mulungu'Nu mundidzaze'ne

hymns.title: Dzuwa liwala
verses:
Dzuwa liwala, dzuwa la m'mwamba
Liunikira mu mtima mwanga
O Aleluya! Ndisekerera
Ndiitane Yesu ali wanga

hymns.title: Tiwaliretu, tiwaliretu
verses:
Tiwaliretu, tiwaliretu
Ambuye Yesu watikondafe
Mulemekeze'ye tsiku lonseli
Inde tiwalire Yesu

hymns.title: Mulungu ngokoma
verses:
Mulungu ngwokoma andithandiza
Andigwira dzanja langa
Mulungu ngwokoma.

hymns.title: Mau akhale amoyo
verses:
Mau akhale amoyo
Ndione Inu momwemo
Ndione ndekha, ndione Yesu
Ndione zonsezo.

hymns.title: Ndiri ndi chuma
verses:
Ndiri ndi chuma chozizwa
Mphatso yosayeseka
Tidzayenda limodzi Baibulo landa ndi ine.

hymns.title: Timkonde Ambuye
verses:
Timkonde Ambuye, timkonde Ambuye
Chifukwa amatikonda, timkonde Ambuye
Timvere Ambuye, timvere Ambuye
Chifukwa amatikonda, timvere Ambuye

hymns.title: Uzani Yesu
verses:
Uzani Yesu, Uzani Yesu
Ndiye bwenzi lomveka
Kulibe bwenzi lina lotere
Uzani Yesu yekha

hymns.title: Uza ena, uza ena
verses:
Uza ena, uza ena, fulumira, uza ena
Yesu awakonda nawafera pamtanda
Fulumira, uza ena.

hymns.title: Zakeyu anali wamfupifupi
verses:
Zakeyu anali wamfupifupi
M'mkuyu nakweramo
Kuti akaone Yesu Mbuye, Mwana wa Mulungutu
Pofika Yesu pa mkuyu anaona Zakeyu
Nanena Zakeyu tsika lero ndidya nanu.

hymns.title: Yesu alinane tsiku lonse
verses:
Yesu alinane tsiku lonse
Pantchito ndi pa masewera
Kwathu ndi kwina konseko
Kodi ndimukonda wondisungayo?

hymns.title: Taona! Taona!
verses:
Taona! Taona! Ndaima pakhomo ndigogoda
Taona! Taona! Ndaima pakhomo ndigogoda
Anyamata akumva mau anga
Asungwana akumva mau anga
Nakatsegula, tsegula, tsegula chitseko, Ndidzalowa

hymns.title: Khalanitu, khulupiliradi
verses:
Khalanitu, khulupiradi,
Khalanitu, mwachikondicho
Khalanitu, penyetsetsa'ye
Mwa Yesu khalanitu

hymns.title: Adandilondola nditasokera
verses:
Anandilondola nditasokera kutaliko;
Anandipezadi, nlodalatu tsikulo

hymns.title: Mudzakhala asodzi
verses:
Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu,
Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu,
Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu,
Mukanditsata,
Mukanditsata,
Mukanditsata,
Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu, Mukanditsata.

hymns.title: Ali wodabwitsa Yesuyo
verses:
Ali wodabwitsa, Yesuyo,
Ali wodabwitsa, Yesuyo,
Maso sanaone, makutu sanamve
Zodabwitsa zonse za Yesuyo.

hymns.title: Andisungadi, Andisungadi
verses:
Andisungadi, andisungadi
Yesu andikonda ine andisungadi.

hymns.title: Yang'anani kwa Yesu
verses:
Yang'anani kwa Yesu
Penyani nkhope yakeyo
Ndi chisomo chake cha Yesuyo
Chikwanitsa zofuna zanu

hymns.title: Yesu wanga, ndikonda Nu
verses:
Yesu wanga ndikonda Nu
Ndikupatsani mtimanga
Lowani lero, khalani muno
Lowani mtimanga Yesu.

hymns.title: Lankhula naye Yesu
verses:
Lankhula naye Yesu zobvutazo,
Lankhula naye Yesu, Iye amvatu
Pa kuyesedwa'we wamphamvu ndi Iyeyu
Polankhula naye athandizatu.

hymns.title: Yesu yemwe adzabweranso
verses:
Yesu yemwe adzabweranso
Adzakhala mfumu ponsepo
Titdzamuona Iye nthawi yomweyo
Dikiranitu.

hymns.title: Chimwemwe chachikulu
verses:
Chimwemwe, chimwemwe chachikulu
Haya, haya, haya, tisangalaletu
Zochimwa zanga zonse afuna kuzichotsa
Abwera msangamsanga posachedwatu.

hymns.title: Ndanitu? Ndanitu?
verses:
Ndanitu? Ndanitu? Adzatsata Yesu? Ndani?
Tsatani Iyeyo tsopanoli, tsata Yesudi.

hymns.title: Khala monga Daniel
verses:
Khala monga Danieli, limba mtima nji!
Usappe anthu, koma tsata Yesudi.

hymns.title: Ayenera kukondwera
verses:
Ayenera kukondedwa, Yesu Mpulumutsiyo
Ayenera akondedwe, adasenza machimo
Wokondedwa wa Mulungu, nazunzidwa pa mtanda
Ayenera kukondedwa, Yesu Mpulumutsiyo

hymns.title: Timange nyumba zathu
verses:
Timange nyumba zathu, zathu, tsiku, tsiku ndi tsiku
Nyundo, nkhwangwa tiribe
Nkhuni, njerwa tiribe
Nanga opanda manjatu, tsata chitsanzo cha Yesu
Ndife a ntchito otani, omanga bwino makhalidwe?

hymns.title: Manja agwira za Yesu
verses:
Manja agwire za Yesu,
Mapazi ayende mwake,
Makutu amve Uthenga
Milomo imyamikire,
Maso apenyere Iye,
Mtima ukhale wake
Zonse ndipatse kwa Yesu, "Ndine wanu, nokha'Nu"

hymns.title: Yesu amakonda ana
verses:
Yesu amakonda ana, ana, onse pansipo
Amitundu yonseyo, akuda ndi oyera
Yesu amakonda ana onsewo.

hymns.title: Ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
verses:
Ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
Chikho changa chisefuka
Yesu andipulumutsa, Yesu andikwaniritsa
Chikho changa chisefuka.

hymns.title: Zikomo Ambuye wanga
verses:
Zikomo Ambuye wanga, zikomo mnandichiritsa
Zikomo mnandipatsatu chipulumutso chachikulu

hymns.title: Odala ali anthu
verses:
Odala ali anthu odziwa Yesu
Otsukidwa m'mwazi wake, oyeratu mbuu!
Mtendere, chipulumutso, chimwemwe ndi zawo
Odala ali anthu odziwa Yesu,

hymns.title: Chisomo chodabwitsa
verses:
Chisomo chodabwitsa chopezekatu pa mtanda
Chokwanira ndi chosatha cha Ambuye Yesu.

hymns.title: Wopambana, wopambana Yesu wa mtanda ngwopambana
verses:
Wopambana, wopambana Yesu wa mtanda ngwopambana
Pa mapazi ake tonse timgwadira
Yesu Ambuyeyo ngwopambana.

hymns.title: Yesu adatipulumutsa ndi ntchito yakeyo
verses:
Yesu adatipulumutsa ndi ntchito yakeyo
Sadadza kuweruza dziko koma kupulumutsa
Timati: Mpulumutsi, Timati: Mpulumutsi
Timati: Mpulumutsi, Dzina labwinotu

hymns.title: Khulupilira Mulungu
verses:
Khulupira Mulungu, ndiye Bwenzi ndithu
Taya pa Yesu nkhawa zonse, amasamalira,
Yimba ndi usana wabwino
Yimba ndi usiku wa mdima;
Tsiku lonse, njira zonse
Tiyeni tiyimbe.

hymns.title: Mulibe nsonizo
verses:
Mulibe nsonizo m'nyumba Mwambamo
Ya Atatewo a Kumwambako
Mulibe nsonizo m'nyumba Mwambamo
Muli chimwemwe chokhacho.

hymns.title: Nditsata Yesu
verses:
Nditsate Yesu tsiku ndi tsiku
Sindidzaopa atsogoleri
M'dzuwa ndi m'nthunzi
Yesu mpulumutsi ali nane.

hymns.title: Mtima uda bii
verses:
Mtima uda bii!
Mpaka Yesu walowa
Mwazi wake ndidziwa wandiyeretsa mbuu!
M'mau ake ndikuzidwa ndidzayenda Kumwamba
Tsiku lodabwitsadi, wanditsuka machimo.

hymns.title: Yesu m'ndikumbutse ine zomwe ndaphunziratu
verses:
Yesu m'ndikumbutse ine zomwe ndaphunziratu
Lembani pamtima panga zoonadi zanuzo
Dalitsanife Ambuye mpaka lisonkhananso
Mtitsogolere nthawi zonse, Mpulumutsi wathu'nu Amen.

hymns.title: Indetu, indetu, ndititu
verses:
Indetu, indetu nditi kwa inu
Indetu, indetu tamveranitu
Okhulupilira Yesu ali ndi moyo wosatha.

hymns.title: Tsegula m'mtima
verses:
Tsegula m'mtima, Yesu agogoda
Tsegula m'mtima, usazengereze
Tsegula m'mtima, Yesu agogoda
Iwe tsegula alowe

hymns.title: Odala oyera mtima,
verses:
Odala oyera mtima,
Odala oyera mtima,
Odala oyera mtima
Adzaona Mulungu.

hymns.title: Ndiri kudya mkate
verses:
Ndiri nkudya mkate wa moyo
Ndiri kumwa madzi a moyo
Iye wakumwa ati Yesu
Ndithu sadzamvanso ludzu
(Asungwana) kodi, sadzamvanso ludzu?
(Anyamata) inde, sadzamvanso ludzu
Iye wakumwa ati Yesu
Ndithu sadzamvanso ludzu

hymns.title: Wandimasula
verses:
Wandimasula, wandimasula
Sindidzayenda m'uchimo
Yesu ndiyetu mombolo wanga
Tsiku ndi tsiku akhale nane

hymns.title: Yesu Ambuye, andikondadi
verses:
Yesu Ambuye, andikondadi
Nafera ine ndipulumuke
Adaukadi nigonja imfa,
Adzabweranso ndisangalale.

hymns.title: Akhala mumtima mwanga
verses:
Akhala mumtima mwanga,
Akhala mumtima mwanga
Sindiopa kanthu ka ufiti omwe
Pokhala mumtima Yesu.

hymns.title: Mtame Yesu
verses:
Mtame Yesu nthawi ya mamawa
Nthawi ya masana
Mtame Yesu pamene dzuwa lilowa
Aleluya!

hymns.title: Uku ndi uko
verses:
Uku ndi uko monga nyanjatu
Chikondi cha Yesu chimandizinga

hymns.title: Tidzamuona Iye
verses:
Tidzamuona Iye, Tidzamuona Iye
Tidzamuona Iye, m'muulemelero wake

hymns.title: Lamulo langa ndilo
verses:
Lamulo langa ndilo;
Mukondane wina ndi m'nzake
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale,
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale,
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale
Lamulo langa ndilo;
Mukondane wina ndi m'nzake
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale

hymns.title: Mphotho ya uchimo
verses:
Mphotho yake ya uchimo ndi imfa,
Mphotho yake ya uchimo ndi imfa
Koma mphotho yaulere ya Mulungu
Ndiyo moyo wosatha.

hymns.title: Yendani poyera
verses:
Yendani poyera, yendani poyera
Tsagana ndi Yesu
Adzathandiza ifenso

hymns.title: Zingakhale zoipa
verses:
Zingakhale zoipa zafiira, ziyera, ziyera, M'mwazi wa Yesu
Zikafira ngati kapezi zidzakhala mbuu, M'mwazi wa Yesu

hymns.title: Ponsepo, ponsepo
verses:
Ponsepo, ponsepo, sindidzaopa
Ponsepo ndi Yesu Ndidzapita.

hymns.title: Ndani agogoda?
verses:
Ndani agogoda pa mtima panga?
Ndi Yesu Ambuye, ndi Yesu Ambuye Afuna alowe.
Kodi akalowa akufuna chiyani?
Kukupulumutsa'we.

hymns.title: Ndine mwana wa nkhosa
verses:
Ndine mwana wa nkhosa wa Mbusa wabwino
Ndiye Yesu, amakonda nkhosa zake zonse
Adafera pa mtanda kuti aziwombole
Kuti zonse zikhale m'khola mwake.

hymns.title: Chikondi cha Yesu ncholingatu
verses:
Chikondi cha Yesu cholingatu m'mwambamo
N'chakuya kuposatu nyanjazo
Wosayenera'ne andisamaliratu
Chikondi chakecho chimandizingatu ponsepo

hymns.title: Manga pa thanthwe
verses:
Manga pa thanthwe siidzagwedezeka
Manga pa thanthwe, osati pa mchenga
Adzaopa namondwe kapena bingu
Uli wosungidwa pomanga pa Yesu

hymns.title: Yesu mbusa wanga ndiyenda nayetu
verses:
Yesu mbusa wanga ndiyenda nayetu
Kumadzi odikha anditsogolera
Nsiku zonse ndiyenda nayetu,
Nsiku zonse ndiyenda nayetu

hymns.title: Mukhale nafe
verses:
Mukhale nafe Yesu, mumphamvu yanu
Chipembedzo chathu mudalitsetu

hymns.title: Ambuye adzanditsogolera
verses:
Ambuye adzanditsogolera mkati mwa chipululu
Ambuye adzanditsogolera, ine ndidzangomtsata
Mphamvu yake adzandipatsa
Ya lero ndi ya mawa yomwe
Ambuye adzanditsogolera, ine ndidzangomtsata.

hymns.title: Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsa
verses:
Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu,
Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu,
Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu,
Ee! Nchodabwitsa!
N'chachikulu sungachizungulire
N'chakuya sungafike pansi pake;
Nchachitali sungathe kuchikwera
Ee! Nchodabwitsa!

hymns.title: Pali chiyanjano ndi chimwemwenso
verses:
Pali chiyanjano ndi chimwemwenso
Potsamira pamkono wake.
Ndine wodala, mtendere ngwanga
Potsamira pa mkono wake.

Potsamira, potsamira
Ndasinthika kuzoopsya;
Potsamira, potsamira
Potsamira pa mkono wake.

hymns.title: Mongatu Yesu
verses:
Mongatu Yesu, mongatu Yesu,
Ndikhale monga Iye
Muulendo onse mpaka kumwamba
Ndikhale monga Iye.

hymns.title: Dzulo, lero
verses:
Dzulo, lero, nsiku zonse Yesu sasintha
Zinthu zonse zimasintha Koma Yesu ayi.
Ulemelero kwa dzina lake
Zinthu zonse zimasintha Koma Yesu ayi
Tiimbe ngati Yesu dzina lakukonda.

hymns.title: Tale wakumwambako
verses:
Tate wakumwambako likayera dzinalo
Chifuniro chanu'cho chichitike pansipa
Mutipatse lero el chakudya chathuchi
Mutikhululukire monga tikhululukira
Mutipulumutse kumayeserowo
Wanu ndi ufumuwo mpaka nthawi zonsezo.

choruses.title: Ndi Yesu ali ndi chifundo nane
Kaya mufune kaya musafune Yesu akubwera
Ine toto kubwerera m'mbuyo ine toto
Ndifuna kufanana ndi Yesu moyo wanga
